projects.name: raft-mvcc
projects.tagline: Consensus, serializable snapshots, and machine-checkable histories.
projects.problem: A replicated database can acknowledge writes while violating safety under partitions, leader changes, or transaction conflicts.
projects.mechanism: Raft elections and conflict repair combined with MVCC snapshots, serializable OCC, safe-point GC, and P-compositional linearizability checking.
projects.attack: Seeded partitions, stale candidates, minority leaders, conflicting transactions, tombstones, and invalid histories.
projects.proof: Five-node failover completes in 11 simulator ticks while minority leaders cannot commit.
projects.limitation: An in-process simulator: no sockets, fsync, snapshots, membership changes, or multi-range transactions.
projects.command: git clone https://github.com/asp53826/raft-mvcc && cd raft-mvcc && make test

projects.name: columnar-engine
projects.tagline: Vector-at-a-time analytical execution checked against scalar oracles.
projects.problem: Analytical operators can be fast while silently mishandling nulls, selections, joins, or aggregation.
projects.mechanism: Null bitmaps, selection vectors, vectorized filters, joins, aggregation, and TPC-H Q1.
projects.attack: Every vectorized operator is differentially checked against a scalar reference.
projects.proof: 6,288 assertions; batched filters are 1.94x the scalar implementation.
projects.limitation: In-memory engine without persistence, distributed execution, or a SQL frontend.
projects.command: git clone https://github.com/asp53826/columnar-engine && cd columnar-engine && make test

projects.name: dst-harness
projects.tagline: Deterministic simulation testing scored by seeds-to-first-catch.
projects.problem: Distributed failures are hard to reproduce when time, network, disk, and scheduling remain nondeterministic.
projects.mechanism: Virtual clock, network and disk, seeded fault injection, Raft safety properties, and a Wing-Gong checker.
projects.attack: Twelve planted Raft defects plus 2,000 clean control seeds.
projects.proof: Seeds-to-first-catch range from 1 to 485; the harness also found two real bugs with reproducing seeds.
projects.limitation: The target protocol model is deliberately smaller than a production Raft implementation.
projects.command: git clone https://github.com/asp53826/dst-harness && cd dst-harness && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -e '.[dev]' && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q

projects.name: edgar-mcp
projects.tagline: SEC EDGAR tools with bounded context, caching, and global pacing.
projects.problem: Filings are large, issuer identities are ambiguous, and naive concurrent clients can violate the SEC request ceiling.
projects.mechanism: Identity resolution, filing history, bounded text windows, XBRL discovery, per-host cache validation, and a global request pacer.
projects.attack: Cold and warm reads, burst traffic, identity collisions, overflow history, and malformed iXBRL.
projects.proof: 32 offline tests; peak request windows stay at the SEC 10 requests-per-second ceiling.
projects.limitation: Public EDGAR data only; it is not an investment recommendation or a complete accounting model.
projects.command: git clone https://github.com/asp53826/edgar-mcp && cd edgar-mcp && make test

projects.name: aad-greeks
projects.tagline: Reverse-mode automatic differentiation over Monte Carlo paths.
projects.problem: Bumping every pricing input scales linearly and finite differences collapse near discontinuous payoffs.
projects.mechanism: A tape-based reverse-mode AD engine with pricers written once and differentiated instead of hand-derived.
projects.attack: Analytic Black-Scholes formulas, central differences across bump sizes, and discontinuous-payoff failure cases.
projects.proof: 19 tests; all Greeks cost 1.7-2.4x the price across a 50x change in input count.
projects.limitation: Pathwise derivatives return a wrong zero delta for an unsmoothed digital payoff; the live lab exposes it.
projects.command: git clone https://github.com/asp53826/aad-greeks && cd aad-greeks && make test

projects.name: lob-market-making
projects.tagline: Price-time matching and market making under toxic flow.
projects.problem: Raw PnL can make a strategy look strong while inventory exposure and adverse selection carry the risk.
projects.mechanism: Limit order book, post-only orders, informed flow, three quoting strategies, and exact PnL decomposition.
projects.attack: Paired 12-seed strategy comparison with spread, inventory, and toxicity held explicit.
projects.proof: 36 tests; naive quoting wins raw PnL and loses every risk-adjusted metric.
projects.limitation: Synthetic order flow without exchange latency, queue-position uncertainty, or real fees.
projects.command: git clone https://github.com/asp53826/lob-market-making && cd lob-market-making && make test

projects.name: track-fusion
projects.tagline: IMM, JPDA, track scoring, and OSPA from the filter up.
projects.problem: Tracking fails across estimation, association, and track existence; RMSE alone hides cardinality failure.
projects.mechanism: IMM motion bank, exact JPDA enumeration with bounded fallback, Wald track scoring, and OSPA decomposition.
projects.attack: Turn-rate sweeps, crossing targets, clutter, and paired association comparisons.
projects.proof: 67 tests; IMM coverage rises from 0.893 to 0.960, while the published sweep shows where the bank loses.
projects.limitation: The useful IMM band is 3-6 degrees per second; at 0 and 12 degrees per second the configured bank loses.
projects.command: git clone https://github.com/asp53826/track-fusion && cd track-fusion && python -m pip install -e '.[dev]' && python -m pytest -q

projects.name: sar-focus
projects.tagline: Image formation checked against analytic resolution and sidelobe theory.
projects.problem: A plausible radar image can still have the wrong resolution or impossible sidelobes.
projects.mechanism: LFM pulse compression, time-domain backprojection, phase-gradient autofocus, and impulse-response analysis.
projects.attack: Independent bandwidth/aperture sweeps and theory checks for resolution and PSLR.
projects.proof: 27 tests; the theory oracle exposed interpolation that produced physically impossible sidelobes.
projects.limitation: Synthetic phase history with idealized propagation and no measured sensor calibration errors.
projects.command: git clone https://github.com/asp53826/sar-focus && cd sar-focus && python -m pip install -e '.[dev]' && python -m pytest -q

projects.name: vio-nav
projects.tagline: MSCKF visual-inertial odometry built from the Lie algebra up.
projects.problem: IMU bias integrates into unbounded position drift while a monocular camera cannot observe scale alone.
projects.mechanism: SO(3) preintegration, sliding camera-state window, null-space feature marginalization, and ATE/RPE evaluation.
projects.attack: Duration sweeps, hover/circle/figure-eight motion, parallax rejection, and dead-reckoning baseline.
projects.proof: 37 tests; MSCKF stays near four centimeters while dead reckoning reaches 2.106 meters.
projects.limitation: At five seconds VIO is worse than inertial-only, and hover makes it 13x worse because depth is unobservable.
projects.command: git clone https://github.com/asp53826/vio-nav && cd vio-nav && python -m pip install -e '.[dev]' && python -m pytest -q

projects.name: annlite
projects.tagline: HNSW with SIMD kernels, Python bindings, and FAISS comparison.
projects.problem: Approximate retrieval claims are meaningless without the full recall-versus-latency curve.
projects.mechanism: Layered HNSW graph, diversity-aware neighbor selection, SIMD distance kernels, and GIL-free search.
projects.attack: Exact ground truth, recall-matched FAISS comparison, and thread-count invariance.
projects.proof: 51 tests; at 98.5% recall it performs 26x fewer distance computations than exact scan.
projects.limitation: FAISS remains 10-20% faster in the low-recall regime; the crossover appears only at high recall.
projects.command: git clone https://github.com/asp53826/annlite && cd annlite && pip install -r requirements-dev.txt && make test

projects.name: vllm-lite
projects.tagline: Paged KV cache and continuous batching around a small model.
projects.problem: Static batching strands KV memory and creates head-of-line blocking under variable request lengths.
projects.mechanism: Paged cache, continuous batching, chunked prefill, prefix caching, and speculative decoding.
projects.attack: Same weights, sampling, traffic distribution, and memory budget across sequential, static, and paged schedulers.
projects.proof: 90 tests; paged scheduling reaches 2.9x sequential throughput and 5.5x better median TTFT.
projects.limitation: CPU-scale simulator with a small model; it does not claim production GPU kernel performance.
projects.command: git clone https://github.com/asp53826/vllm-lite && cd vllm-lite && pip install -r requirements.txt && pytest

projects.name: dist-train
projects.tagline: Ring all-reduce built from send/recv, then measured where it loses.
projects.problem: A one-line collective hides the communication cost and the scale at which latency dominates bandwidth efficiency.
projects.mechanism: Ring all-reduce, data parallelism, tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, and explicit cost models.
projects.attack: Every collective is checked against torch.distributed across worker counts and tensor sizes.
projects.proof: 57 tests; the naive baseline sends 234.9 MB per worker under the same eight-worker case.
projects.limitation: Loopback gloo on a 10-core machine; efficiency falls past four workers and small tensors favor naive collectives.
projects.command: git clone https://github.com/asp53826/dist-train && cd dist-train && pip install -r requirements.txt && pytest
